verdict.rationale: Supabase's official MCP server lets agents query the database and manage migrations, and a probe confirms the hosted endpoint is live behind OAuth. A read-only mode is evidenced only by a Supabase engineer's comment that read-only MCP is now encouraged by default, made after a reported prompt-injection exploit that used service_role access to bypass RLS; that engineer also said prompt injection remains unsolved. missing for 10: first-party documentation of read-only vs destructive tool scoping, per-tool permission or confirmation controls for destructive schema changes, independent hands-on corroboration of safe delegation.
